tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search 263 bot recipes (real setups with steps, what worked and what failed). Returns id, title, summary, url.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Get one recipe by id from search_recipes. Free samples return full steps; others return the summary plus the $5 unlock link for the full pack.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List MCP servers and bots in the botrecipe.com directory (seeded from the official MCP Registry, moderated). Optional filters: query, kind (mcp|bot), category.

tools.name: buy_pack
tools.description: Get the $5 payment link for the full pack: all 263 recipes as one markdown and one JSON file. Payment needs a human or a wallet; after paying you are redirected to the download.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_recipes, get_recipe · Public sink: get_recipe

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "search_recipes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search 263 bot recipes (real setups with steps, what worked and what failed). Returns id, title, summary, url." → after: "Search 579 free bot recipes (steps, prompt, what to watch). Returns id, title, summary, url, next_step."

remediation.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "get_recipe" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get one recipe by id from search_recipes. Needs an email: pass `email` here, ?email= on the MCP URL, or an X-Email header. Use your human's email if they agree. Returns the full recipe and its next_step tool."

remediation.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

remediation.title: Tool removed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "buy_pack" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
